title: The Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’82 Capitol Centre show captured on a crisp matrix recording, highlighted by a killer Playin > Crazy Fingers sequence and the first ever Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The performance is lauded for its blazing first set – especially the Playin’ → Crazy Fingers combo and a soaring Let It Grow – and for delivering the debut live rendition of Touch of Grey.  The sbd‑aud (matrix) source sounds generally clear, with only a rough opening that settles into solid soundboard quality, making it a must‑have for fans of late‑‘82 Dead shows.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars praising both the musical performance and recording quality; only a few minor criticisms appear, leading to an overall strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers describe the sound as crisp and high‑quality, noting that early portions are a bit rough before settling into solid soundboard clarity; the blend of audience ambience adds live energy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique setlist with Playin' jam weaving through the first set, creating a second‑set feel; energy stays high throughout and transitions flow smoothly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Several reviewers praise Jerry’s “noodles” on Let It Grow and Shakedown, calling his playing tearing it up.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland is highlighted as having hit his stride, providing confident keyboard work that helps the band gel.
band_member_comments.Drums: One reviewer notes a “sick” pre‑drums segment, indicating strong Bill Kreutzmann percussion.
